diagnostics.view_dependence: Four correlated views inherit each native source. View counts are not independent screenshot counts.

report.scope: Fresh controlled iOS native nine-family scenes plus reused R17 native regression; four correlated views per source. No Android-native accuracy claim.

limits: Four views share each source; view counts are correlated.
All labeled new data is controlled iOS Simulator rendering, including vendor fonts. No Android-native accuracy claim.
Native-region evaluation uses ground-truth crops and is not the old full-page detection evaluation.
Roboto is an auxiliary competing class, not a formally named output.
Original CAL failures stay failed; the product objective was revised after CAL, before TEST.
Some correct results abstain; both classifiers can still agree on a wrong font.
